plan.title: Cancel Manage Line Items in Saved Draft

steps.note: Enable eRFX projects as required by the case.
Apply the required vendor-lock configuration for event creation.
Apply the case's required stage configuration.
Open Events so the saved draft can be reached from the Drafts tab.
Confirm the events list rendered successfully.
Open the first saved draft, which lands on its create screen.
Record the expected one-line-item state before opening the manager.
Open the Manage Line Items window for the draft.
Confirm the line-item management window opened.
Cancel the drawer without saving any changes.
Verify that Cancel closes the Manage Line Items window.
Verify the draft still has the same single line item after cancellation.
